cur-fossil-denisova.dateNote: In 2008 a child's finger bone was dug from this cave in Siberia's Altai Mountains. Its DNA, read in 2010, revealed a lost kind of human: the Denisovans. The bone is about 76,000–52,000 years old (under 0.1 million years).

cur-find-chagyrskaya.dateNote: DNA from Neanderthals in this cave in Russia's Altai Mountains, about 54,000 years old, included a father and his teenage daughter: the first known Neanderthal family (Skov et al., Nature, 2022).
